CLI tooling for capability catalog management

breaking.description: Project entity renamed to Product; `project_id` field renamed to `product_id` in event payloads and database schemas

added.description: Product entity replacing Project with capabilities edge
Capability entity for modeling major functional areas within a Product
Feature entity for specific functionality within a Capability
Journey can now optionally link to a Feature via `feature_id`
Capability catalog types (`CapabilityCatalog`, `Capability`, `Feature`) for import/export
`schemagen` CLI tool for JSON Schema generation from Go types
Embedded JSON Schema for capability catalog validation
`catalog2md` CLI tool for converting catalogs to markdown
`catalogctl` CLI with validate and convert commands

highlights.description: Analytics integration with Amplitude and Mixpanel via omnidxi
Fan-out publisher for multi-destination event dispatch

added.description: Analytics adapter mapping ProductGraph events to omnidxi format
MultiPublisher for parallel fan-out to multiple event destinations
Config package with environment variable support
Amplitude provider integration via omni-amplitude
Mixpanel provider integration via omni-mixpanel

documentation.description: v0.2.0 ideation document for analytics adapters and SDK design

highlights.description: Initial release of ProductGraph event ingestion service
PostgreSQL-based Starter architecture with Row-Level Security for multi-tenancy

added.description: Event ingestion HTTP service (`POST /v1/events`) with batch support (max 1000 events)
Health (`GET /health`) and readiness (`GET /ready`) endpoints

Ent ORM schemas for Organization, Project, Event, Session, Journey
PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) for multi-tenancy via `org_id`
Database indexes optimized for time-series queries
Docker Compose development environment with PostgreSQL 16
Makefile with build, test, generate, and migrate commands
